name: Serious Lionfish 75
author: Jaareet
description: Cyan text input that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 .15vw #87cfeb. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 .15vw #87ceeb.
html: <input type="text" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Write a message">
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Serious Lionfish 75</title>
<style>
/* Serious Lionfish 75 by Jaareet — https://uiverse.io/Jaareet/serious-lionfish-75 */
.input {
  font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Roboto","Oxygen","Ubuntu","Cantarell","Fira Sans","Droid Sans","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: .8vw;
  color: #fff;
  background-color: rgb(28,28,30);
  box-shadow: 0 0 .4vw rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 .15vw transparent;
  border-radius: 0.4vw;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0.4vw;
  max-width: 190px;
  transition: .4s;
}

.input:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .15vw rgba(135, 207, 235, 0.186);
}

.input:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .15vw skyblue;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" name="text" class="input" placeholder="Write a message">

</body>
</html>
